responsibility: Defines rustc_target’s shared function-call ABI model and dispatch for computing `FnAbi`, then applies architecture-specific lowering rules for each supported target. The module’s core (`mod.rs`) provides the common pass-mode, argument-attribute, cast-target, and calling-convention infrastructure, while the per-target files implement how arguments and returns are classified for AArch64, AMDGPU, ARM, AVR, BPF, CSKY, Hexagon, LoongArch, M68k, MIPS/MIPS64, MSP430, NVPTX64, PowerPC/PowerPC64, RISC-V, s390x, SPARC/SPARC64, WebAssembly, x86/x86_64/Win64, and Xtensa—covering target-specific decisions such as scalar extension, homogeneous float/vector aggregate handling, register and stack assignment, vararg accounting, byval and cast-based coercions, direct versus indirect passing/return, and ABI-family quirks needed to present a correct lowering of Rust and C-like calls across architectures.
